mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_product(category_id, title, price, stock, rating, image_url, source_url, status) VALUES(#{categoryId}, #{title}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{rating}, #{imageUrl}, #{sourceUrl}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_product SET category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, rating = #{rating} WHERE id = #{id}
